About us:
We have a policy – to build Precise tools which are of highest quality and to extend excellent technical 
service to our channel partners and to the consumers.
The High-Speed Steel and carbide rods used for manufacturing the above tools are of highest quality and 
procured from various parts of the world including India.
We are an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certi ed company, manufactures tools usingstate-of-the art 
manufacturing technology,a well-equipped metallurgical lab, high-quality CNC machines,precision quality 
control equipments and Innovation centre which has put our metal cutting tools on par with the best brands 
of cutting tools in the world.
Distribution of the above products in India is primarily done through the network of Authorized Dealers and 
Sub Dealers. We also supply products to the end users directly based on their requirements.
We also export HSS and Carbide Tools to many countries. We are recognized for our exports by Engineering 
Export Promotion Council of India every year for the last Twenty-Five Years for being the Largest 
Exporter of Cutting Tools from India.

Manufacturing Notes
The following notes apply to the manufacture and supply of
• Milling Cutters
• End Mills
• Slot Drills and 
• Taps.
They supplement the size/standard chart above and govern tooth form, surcharge applicability, and supply 
convention.
a) Milling Cutters
 1. Side & Face Cutters are supplied to BSS —Type B (Straight Teeth).Slotting Cutters are supplied to 
BSS.Cutters of 3/4” width and above are supplied with LH helix asstandard.
 2. Keyway Milling Cutters are radially turned with staggered teeth and without a corner radius.
 3. Convex Cutters, Concave Cutters, and Single Corner Rounding Cutters are radially machine-turned 
and relieved.

6
b) End Mills
 1. Parallel Shank End Mills
 Type ‘N’ with RH helical  utes for RH cutting are supplied as standard.
 • Long Series End Mills can be supplied at 30% surcharge over the standard price, subject to the following 
minimum order quantities (MOQ):
 ◦ Up to 13 mm — 100Pcs each
 ◦ 14 mm to 16 mm — 50 Pcs each
 ◦ 17 mm to 22 mm — 25 Pcs each
 ◦ Above 22 mm—10 Pcs each
 2. Taper Shank End Mills
 • Tanged Taper-Shank End Mills in Tool Type ‘N’ with LH helical  utes for RH cutting are supplied as 
standard.
c) Slot Drills
 1. Parallel Shank Slot Drills
 • Metric sizes — Type ‘A’  at face of short series slot drills with RH helical  utes for RH cutting and Tool 
Type H are supplied as standard, unless otherwise speci ed.
 • Inch sizes — RH cutting with RH helical  utes is supplied as standard.
 • Prices and MOQ for the standard series can be supplied on request.
 2. Taper Shank Slot Drills
 • RH cutting with RH helical  utes are supplied as standard.
d) Taps
 1. Hand Taps — Metric Coarse Pitch (MCP)
 A set consists of Taper,Second and Bottoming.
 Part 2 design is supplied from3mm to10m
 Part 3 design is supplied above 10 mm.
 2. Hand Taps — Metric Fine Pitch (MFP)
 A set consists of Taper and Bottoming.
 Part 2 design is supplied from 3 mm to 10 mm
 Part 3 design is supplied above 10 mm.
 3. Long Shank Machine Taps
 • Type A — 5° taper angle with long taper lead.
 • Type B — 10° taper lead angle with spiral point.
 • Type C — 20° taper angle with short taper lead.
 • Type D — 10° taper angle without spiral point.
 4. BSP (P), NPS, NPSF, BSPT, NPT & NPTF
 A set consists of 2 taps (Taper and Bottoming).

 5. BS CON (British Standard Conduit)& BSCY (British Standard Cycle)
 A set consists of 3 taps (Taper, Second and Bottoming).
 BSP (Parallel) Taps to the new BS 949 (Part 3) — 1982 (G/TP series) can also be supplied at the
